title: Anchoring Speech with Semantics: A Multimodal Adapter Mechanism for Automatic Speech Recognition in Low-Resource Languages
abstract: arXiv:2608.29239v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-resource ASR remains difficult because scarce transcripts provide limited supervised evidence for target-side generation. To address this gap, we propose SAMA-ASR, a lightweight adapter mechanism that augments the decoder with semantic anchors from auxiliary translations and an acoustic anchor from speech; in principle, the mechanism can be applied to similar encoder--decoder multitask speech models. Through cross-modal adaptation, SAMA-ASR conditions decoder states on translation-derived semantic embeddings and a speech embedding, combining utterance-level meaning with speech-grounded evidence before token prediction. At evaluation time, these semantic anchors can be generated automatically by an upstream speech-to-text translator rather than supplied as oracle translations. translated_abstract: 低资源语音识别（ASR）仍然是一个难题，因为稀缺的转录文本为目标端生成提供的监督证据十分有限。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了SAMA-ASR，这是一种轻量级的适配器机制，通过来自辅助翻译的语义锚点和来自语音的声学锚点来增强解码器；原则上，该机制可应用于类似的编码器-解码器多任务语音模型。通过跨模态适配，SAMA-ASR使解码器状态以翻译导出的语义嵌入和语音嵌入为条件，在词元预测之前将话语级含义与语音基础证据相结合。在评估阶段，这些语义锚点可以由上游的语音到文本翻译系统自动生成，而无需提供人工翻译。在两个30小时数据集（涵盖低资源汉语变体台湾闽南语和客家话）上的实验表明，SAMA-ASR优于声学、先验……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SAMA-ASR轻量级多模态适配器机制，利用辅助翻译生成的语义锚点与语音声学锚点共同增强解码器，在低资源语言（台湾闽南语和客家话）的语音识别任务上取得了显著提升。
en_tdlr: SAMA-ASR, a lightweight multimodal adapter mechanism that augments the ASR decoder with semantic anchors derived from auxiliary translations and an acoustic anchor from speech, significantly improves speech recognition for low-resource languages such as Taiwanese Hokkien and Hakka.
